# plasmoRUtils

`plasmoRUtils` enables users to connect to several *Plasmodium* and
other apicomplexan databases via R interface and provides simple
functions to carry out other bioinformatics tasks which are non-trival
for parasite bioinformatic analysis. For further details, we recommend
you read our
[preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.07.30.667718v1).

## Installation

The easiest way to download package is as follows

``` r

pak::pkg_install("Rohit-Satyam/plasmoRUtils", dependencies = TRUE)
```

If the above method fails, try the following steps:

1.  Before downloading the package, install the following dependencies.

``` r

cranpkgs <- c('BiocManager','randomcoloR', 'janitor', 'readr', 'rlang', 'dplyr', 'rvest',
'easyPubMed', 'plyr', 'scales', 'ggplot2', 'tidyr', 'tibble', 'data.table', 'plotly',
'purrr', 'stringr', 'S4Vectors', 'magrittr', 'bio3d', 'httr2', 'jsonlite', 'gt', 'mgsub', 'reshape2','pathfindR')

install.packages(setdiff(cranpkgs, rownames(installed.packages())), dependencies = TRUE)

biocpkgs <- c("rmarkdown","pRoloc","knitr","BiocStyle","DESeq2","styler","utils","IRanges",
"BiocGenerics","rtracklayer","scuttle","txdbmaker","topGO","drawProteins","GenomicFeatures",
"biomaRt","AnnotationForge","Biostrings","GenomeInfoDb","SingleCellExperiment",
"SingleR","NOISeq","GenomicRanges","BSgenome")

BiocManager::install(setdiff(biocpkgs, rownames(installed.packages())), dependencies = TRUE)
```

2.  You can install the development version of `plasmoRUtils` using:

``` r

devtools::install_github("Rohit-Satyam/plasmoRUtils")
remotes::install_github('Rohit-Satyam/plasmoRUtils')
```

## Check installation

Once dependencies are installed, the package can be loaded as follows:

``` r

# Once installed load the library as
library(plasmoRUtils)

## To re-check if all the dependencies that are required by plasmoRUtils are installed
install_dependencies()
```

## Contributing

We’re excited to have you contribute to this package! If you’d like to
help out, try to follow the same style and conventions used in the
current functions - where it makes sense, of course. If you have any
ideas or suggestions, don’t hesitate to reach out—opening a GitHub issue
is usually the best way to start the conversation.

> Just a heads up: this project has a Contributor Code of Conduct, so by
> getting involved, you’re agreeing to play by those rules. Thanks for
> helping make this project better!

# Package index

## Install dependencies

- [`install_dependencies()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/install_dependencies.md)
  : Install package dependencies

## Search functions

These functions provides CLI access to various databases

- [`searchApicoTFdb()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchApicoTFdb.md)
  : Fetch data from ApicoTFdb
- [`searchHP()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchHP.md)
  : Fetch Protein-protein interaction for given gene IDs from Hit
  Predict database
- [`searchIpDb()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchIpDb.md)
  : Fetch orthologs from InParanoiDb
- [`searchKipho()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchKipho.md)
  : Fetch Kinases and Phosphatases from Kipho Database
- [`searchMidb()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchMidb.md)
  : Fetch Minor intron tables from MiDB
- [`searchMiip()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchMiip.md)
  : Fetch Protein-Protein interactions from MIIP database
- [`searchPhPl()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchPhPl.md)
  : Fetch data tables from PhenoPlasm database
- [`searchPM()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchPM.md)
  : Fetch articles from PubMed database
- [`searchRS()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchRS.md)
  : Fetch articles from Research Square database
- [`searchTedConsensus()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/searchTedConsensus.md)
  : Fetch protein domains from TED database

## Fetching tables from databases

These functions helps users fetch annotations and data in form of tables
from various databases.

- [`getEffLen()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/getEffLen.md)
  : Get effective gene lengths form TPM calculation
- [`getMpmp()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/getMpmp.md)
  : Quickly fetch data from MPMP database
- [`getpairedOrthologs()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/getpairedOrthologs.md)
  : Fetch paired orthologs
- [`getPreconfiguredTable()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/getPreconfiguredTable.md)
  : Get pre-configured tables
- [`getPreconfiguredTableOrthomcl()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/getPreconfiguredTableOrthomcl.md)
  : Get pre-configured tables from OrthoMCL-DB
- [`getTable()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/getTable.md)
  : Get tables with custom fields
- [`listipdb()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/listipdb.md)
  : List species metadata present in InparanoiDB 9
- [`listMCA()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/listMCA.md)
  : List data sets in MCA
- [`listOrthomcl()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/listOrthomcl.md)
  : List species metadata present in OrthoMCL
- [`listVeupathdb()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/listVeupathdb.md)
  : List genomes and metadata in VEuPathDB

## Plotting functions

These functions helps users make publication ready plots quickly.

- [`plotAllCondition()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/plotAllCondition.md)
  : Making plots similar to malaria.tools
- [`plotDomain()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/plotDomain.md)
  : Plotting domains on protein body
- [`plotStageSpecific()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/plotStageSpecific.md)
  : Making plots similar to malaria.tools

## Easy functions

Perform ruting bioinfrmatic tasks on non-model organisms quick and easy.

- [`easyAF2Signal()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyAF2Signal.md)
  : Check Signal peptide fidelity
- [`easyExpPlot()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyExpPlot.md)
  : Plot Normalised expression quickly
- [`easyGOPlot()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyGOPlot.md)
  : Quick ORA result plotting
- [`easyLabelTransfer()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyLabelTransfer.md)
  : Easy label transfer from reference data
- [`easymakeOrgdb()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easymakeOrgdb.md)
  : Create Org.db package quickly
- [`easyMCA()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyMCA.md)
  : Fetch data from Malaria Cell Atlas
- [`easyNOISeqAnnot()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyNOISeqAnnot.md)
  : Get NOISeq::readData ready annotations
- [`easyPhplplottbl()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyPhplplottbl.md)
  : Quickly plot PhenoPlasm summary tables
- [`easytopGO()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easytopGO.md)
  : Performing quick ORA analysis
- [`easyTPM()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyTPM.md)
  : Calculate TPM values from count data
- [`easyTxDbmaker()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/easyTxDbmaker.md)
  : Quickly make TxDb object

## ID conversin

Convert one ID type to another

- [`pdb2uniprot()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/pdb2uniprot.md)
  : Quick mapping of PDB IDs to Uiprot IDs
- [`toGeneid()`](https://rohit-satyam.github.io/plasmoRUtils/reference/toGeneid.md)
  : Convert Other IDs to Ensembl gene IDs
